cases.scopeLine: Verified: OS, instance name, SQL version, database names and count against the host. Not verified (not shown by NBR): database sizes, .mdf/.ldf paths, IP address as a separate field.

cases.title: [MSSQL-Disc-WF-0011] Verify Always On AG Metadata Discovery
cases.exclusionReason: Needs a multi-replica Always On AG with a listener; the lab AG is a single-replica Basic AG. Excluded by owner decision 2026-10-09.

cases.title: [MSSQL-Disc-WF-0012] Verify Read-Scale AG Metadata Discovery
cases.scopeLine: Verified: Read-Scale AG type, AG name, databases and SQL version. Not verified (not shown by NBR): replicas, replica roles, clustering flag.
cases.notVerified: Replica list, primary/secondary replicas, the clustering flag (IsClustered = false) and any secondary replica: the UI shows none of them. Replica roles and a replica list are not exposed in the UI and are not verified.
